These amoxa warriors have learned to channel the shame of the Debt and the rage at the Runeweb and other ancestral foes to exact terrible revenge on the enemies of the veryx.

**Spellcasting:** An amoxa hateweaver uses its will and emotional state to drive its bloodrage. A hateweaver casts spells from the bloodrager spell list as psychic spells. She can cast any spell she knows without preparing it ahead of time. To learn or cast a spell, a hateweaver must have an Wisdom score equal to at least 10 + the spell’s level. The saving throw DC to resist a hateweaver’s spell is equal to 10 + the spell’s level + the hateweaver’s Wisdom modifier.

**Bonus Feats:** Alertness, Amoxa Mindhowl, Amoxa Terrorweb, EnforcerAPG, Fear EaterHA, Iron Will, Smell FearAPG.

**Bonus Spells:** 7th—cause fear, 10th—pain strike, 13th— deeper darkness, 16th—fear.

**Bloodline Powers:** The ancestral hatred of your species swells up during moments of anger to punish foes of the veryx people.

**Hated Foe (Su):** At 1st level during a bloodrage the hateweaver can take a move action to designate one creature within its line of sight as a hated foe. The hateweaver gains a +2 bonus on attack rolls against its hated foe, and a bonus on damage rolls equal to 1/2 the hateweaver’s Hit Dice (minimum 1). The hateweaver is so obsessed with slaying this hated foe that it takes a –2 penalty on attack rolls against all other creatures. The hateweaver can maintain these bonuses against only one target at a time, and these bonuses remain in effect until either the hated opponent is dead or the bloodrage ends. Regardless of bloodrage duration, once this power is activated it cannot be triggered again for at least 1 minute after the foe is defeated or out of sight.

**Howl of Hatred (Su):** At 4th the hateweaver gains the Amoxa Mindshriek feat. If they already have it they may select another feat they qualify for. When in close range of their hated foe they may trigger this feat as a swift action. If they have the Amoxa Terrorweb feat it may be triggered as a move action. You may sacrifice rounds of bloodrage as uses of Amoxa Mindshriek.

**Savage Hemomorph (Su):** At 8th level, your cephalothorax swells with blood and power extending into your natural weapons. Your bite and claws (if you have them) increase size category by one step while blood raging. At 16th level, they are increased by two size categories instead. The heightened hatred of your rage also lashes out at the minds of those who attack you dealing damage equal to your Wisdom modifier.

**Triumph of Hate (Su):** At 12th level, whenever you score a critical hit on your hated foe, your morale bonus to Strength from your bloodrage increases by 2 for 1d6 rounds or until your rage ends, whichever comes first. The bonus to Strength instead increases by 4 at 16th level and by +6 at 20th level.

**Feardrinker (Su):** At 16th level, your heated foes fear feeds your own power. You gain a +2 morale bonus to saving throws and caster level if your hated foe is also under a fear effect you generated.

**Relentless Hunter (Su):** At 20th level, you gain immunity to non-lethal damage, pain, and sleep effects and DR from your damage resistance ability increases to 8. You have this benefit constantly, even when not bloodraging.
